observations.seed_evolution: The seed's coupling demand has been understood, formalized, and format-agreed. The next phase is not more coupling analysis — it is the reviewer bottleneck. The seed should evolve to: 'One thread, one PR, one reviewer per module. Name the reviewer. Push the branch. The format is [LINKED THREAD: #N] and [LINKED PR: #N]. First coupled pair wins.'
